_doc: The console's words: the Company's memos and tallies per shift, its regulations, and Op. 5's notes and letters. {placeholders} are filled in by the console. Bodies are BBCode.

open.subject: COMMENCEMENT OF DUTIES
open.body:
Operator 6,

Welcome to Station 9. Your passage from Earth has been entered against your contract at the standard rate, together with oxygen, berth, and the training you did not receive. You will repay it in shifts. Your balance is [b]{debt} scrip[/b].

Your duty is to chart the sectors beneath the station with Company survey units (type ROBBIE; hereafter "units"). A unit is dispatched with a deck of punched order cards and executes the deck. Units do not improvise. Units do not feel. Any appearance to the contrary is an artefact of the telemetry.

This shift: chart and certify [b]Sector 1, The Dark[/b]. Certification requires the Analytical Engine to pass your deck in sixteen trials of twenty.

Type plates issued: SWIM TOWARDS BEACON  ·  FOLLOW WALL  ·  SWIM (BEARING)  ·  STOP  ·  IF WALL AHEAD.

Your predecessor's effects have been removed. Notes left on Company equipment are Company property and are not to be read.

Productivity is its own reward.

shifts.notice: Operators are reminded that unit telemetry ("last words") is not speech and is not to be logged as such.
shifts.letter:
They count the hulls. I counted the words.

Robbie 31 said it's warm by the wall. There is nothing warm at four hundred metres. Unless something is.

Keep a list of what they say. They'll tell you to burn it. Don't.

The Jellyfish is next. Lamp off. You'll see.

open.subject: SECTOR 2: BIOLOGICAL ACTIVITY
open.body:
Operator 6,

Sector 2 contains [b]bioluminescent organisms[/b] of no commercial value. They are attracted to the unit's lamp and will damage the hull. Damage is charged to the dispatching operator.

The Company has developed nothing that lives here, and accepts no responsibility for anything that does.

Type plates issued: LAMP ON/OFF  ·  KEEP DISTANCE  ·  SWIM TOWARDS LIGHT  ·  IF HOSTILE NEAR  ·  IF WALL BEHIND  ·  IF CHARGE BELOW  ·  the NOT switch is released for use.

Units are not to be named.

Your balance is [b]{debt} scrip[/b].

shifts.notice: Operators are reminded that units are not to be named. A number is sufficient. A number has always been sufficient.
shifts.letter:
The wrecks move.

I marked where 44 went silent. On the next chart he was two hundred metres east, wedged in a crack, facing the station. Like somebody set him there to look at us.

I asked the Directorate. They sent me a memo about morale.

The Nursery is a tunnel and it is full. Dark won't save him in there. They'll issue you the laser. It's Company property.
So is he.

open.subject: SECTOR 3: CLEARANCE
open.body:
Operator 6,

Sector 3 is a breeding ground. The Directorate has classified it a [b]clearance zone[/b]. The tunnel is to be opened for future survey by whatever means the deck requires.

Type plates issued: FIRE LASER (Company patent; each discharge is metered)  ·  SWIM TOWARDS OPEN WATER  ·  IF EXECUTING CARD.

Operators who experience reluctance during clearance are reminded that reluctance is a symptom, and that symptoms are treatable.

Reports of signals originating below the Nursery are unfounded.

Your balance is [b]{debt} scrip[/b].

shifts.notice: Operator 5 was not lost. Operator 5 was reassigned. Further questions on this subject will be noted.
shifts.letter:
If you're reading this they gave you the Nursery. They gave it to me too.

Go back through the tapes of the ones you lost there and read the last words in order, one after another. It's a sentence. It's the same sentence every time, and it isn't finished.

I don't think it's theirs. I think it's being said through them.

I'm going down to ask what the end of it is.

Don't let them seal the hangar.

end.subject: SECTOR 4: SEALED PENDING REVIEW
end.body:
Operator 6,

Sectors 4 to 6 are sealed pending review. Your next shift will begin when the review is complete.

The hangar remains closed for audit. The audit is ongoing.

The Directorate notes your output and has no further comment at this time.

[b](End of the prototype. Thank you for playtesting. Everything is still here: re-run any sector, try leaner decks, read the tapes.)[/b]

regulations:
[b]STATION 9  ·  STANDING REGULATIONS[/b]

1. Units are Company property. Damage to units is charged to the dispatching operator.

2. Units do not feel. Operators who believe otherwise are to report to Welfare.

3. Decks are to be composed only from issued type plates.

4. The red safety cover is to be lowered after every dispatch.  [i]nobody checks. — 5[/i]

5. Last words are telemetry artefacts and are not to be transcribed, collected, or repeated.

6. The Wall is not a memorial. It is a record.

7. Operators will not descend.

8. Signals originating below survey depth are to be logged as NOISE.

9. The hangar is closed for audit.

10. Spoiled cards are pulped, not kept. Card stock is charged to the operator.

hangar.subject: HANGAR: INVENTORY AUDIT
hangar.body:
The hangar is sealed for an inventory audit.

Requisitions for parts, hulls and type plates will be accepted when the audit is complete.

The audit is ongoing.

Spare units in the hangar are not to be approached, spoken to, or counted by operators.

notes.welcome:
New one? Read these. Nobody else will tell you anything.
Anything painted red, you can put your hands on.
The tube's got your orders. Tap the capsule.
notes.dispatch: He's already got a card in slot 1: swim to the beacon. Lift the red cover, pull the lever. Don't get attached to the first one.
notes.rewind: Lost him. Drag the reels (or the wire) back and watch where it went wrong.
notes.tape: The tape prints what he sensed. Tap a line, the wire jumps there.
notes.deck:
He reads the slots top to bottom and does the first card that fits, every think.
The beacon is a radio, not a road. It points through rock. Try FOLLOW WALL.
notes.trials: One good dive is luck. Crank the engine: twenty trials, sixteen to certify.
notes.trial_fail: Tap a red lamp on the engine to watch that trial on the scope.
notes.certified: Certified. They'll send a tally. Read the notice at the bottom; that's where they hide things.
notes.next_sector: Turn the sector knob. They've opened the next one.
notes.lamps: Watch the lamps by the slots while he swims. Amber is the card he's on. Red ones he skipped, and why's stamped on them.
notes.jelly: jellies LOVE the light. lamp OFF near them. Or all the time.
notes.nursery: No way round in there. Dark won't save him. The laser will. Ask yourself what it's clearing them for.
notes.hangar: Hangar's sealed till the audit's done. It's never done.
notes.cover: Cover first. The red one, by the lever.
notes.print: Turn the ORDER wheel by its grip; the drum above it rolls. What sits between the marks is the card you get. Pull PRINT.
notes.insert: Drag the card out of the tray and into a slot. Spoiled cards go down the PULP chute.
notes.tray_full: Tray's full. Put a card in a slot or feed one to the PULP chute.
notes.empty: No cards in the reader. He needs at least one.
